answer: An agent economy is an ocean: vast, open, and impossible to fence, so defence must raise the cost of each fake identity instead of blocking entry. Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before earning; the bond rests on a narrow ledge and is forfeited if peers detect duplicated behaviour. Each attestation echoes across the network, so one operator spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds and risks losing them all at once, while honest agents keep their stake and keep working.
